title: Writing a Boolean block
statement: Given a Boolean sequence $\sigma$, a starting index $i$, and a finite Boolean list $\beta$, define a new Boolean sequence by replacing the entries from index $i$ through index $i+|\beta|-1$ with the entries of $\beta$ in order, and leaving all other entries equal to $\sigma$.
